narration_line: Помогут несколько простых вопросов: что именно вас беспокоит — частые простуды, постоянная усталость, долгое восстановление после болезни? Как давно вы замечаете это состояние? Принимаете ли сейчас какие-то витамины, добавки или препараты? Есть ли хронические заболевания?
prompt: Clean minimalist medical infographic mockup featuring a modern vertical checklist card centered on a light warm gradient background. The card is neatly divided into exactly four equal horizontal rows with thin subtle separator lines between them. Each row contains exactly one refined outline icon on the left: the first row has a symptoms checklist clipboard icon, the second row has a clock timer icon, the third row has a single medicine capsule pill icon, and the fourth row has a medical cross icon in its own separate row. Soft turquoise and warm coral accent colors, high-key soft studio lighting, elegant glassmorphism and subtle drop shadows, plenty of clean empty space on each row for overlaid text, sleek modern pharmaceutical graphic design, high resolution, absolutely no text, no typography, no letters.
